_comment: Subjects where no draft in the batch was acceptable. Fix the prompt in subjects.py, then: python build_set.py --force --only <slug> ...

rejected.dryosaurus: Rendered a literal DEER with a saddle. Cause: 'about the size of a large deer'.
rejected.protoceratops: Rendered a hairless SHEEP with a vestigial frill. Cause: 'sheep-sized'.
rejected.micro_raptor: Rendered a plain CROW. Cause: 'crow-sized'; the four feathered limbs never appeared.
rejected.deinonychus: Rendered a WOLF/coyote. Cause: 'the size of a large wolf'.
rejected.iguanodon: Rendered a hairless BULL/warthog. No mammal comparison used, but 'heavy-bodied herbivore on all fours' lands in cattle territory anyway. Spiked thumbs absent.
rejected.utahraptor: Rendered a giant EAGLE with a saddle. Cause: the word 'raptor' collides with bird-of-prey. Sickle claws absent; the picket line behind is full of horses.
rejected.diplodocus: Neck far too short - reads as a hippo/camel hybrid, not a sauropod. Frame 1 also has a modern car in the background.
rejected.thomas_reed: Reads about 4 rather than 7, and the pose (squatting over a basket) is unfortunate. Anachronistic footwear.

marginal.ankylosaurus: Too upright and theropod-headed; no club tail. Usable but not right.
marginal.apatosaurus: Same short-neck problem as diplodocus, though less severe. Frame 2 is passable.
marginal.pip_aquilops: Charming, but reads as a small bird rather than a horned dinosaur - no frill, no beak ridge.
marginal.stegosaurus: Body and plates correct, but wearing a toothy predator's head.
marginal.triceratops: Good, but frames 0 and 1 carry faint text artifacts along the bottom edge.

systemic.mammal_size_comparison: NEVER describe a dinosaur by comparison to a mammal. Every single outright failure used one, and Klein rendered the mammal. Give absolute measurements and explicit reptile/dinosaur anatomy instead.
systemic.raptor_word_collision: 'Raptor' means bird-of-prey to the model. Say 'dromaeosaur', name the sickle claw, and say 'not a bird'.
systemic.sauropod_necks: Sauropods come out with necks far too short. Needs explicit 'neck as long as its body' phrasing.
systemic.herbivore_heads: Stegosaurs and kentrosaurs get theropod heads with teeth. Specify a small beaked head on a long neck.
systemic.costume_period: NOT A DEFECT - ACCEPTED BY CHLOE 2026-08-20. Clothing reads 1930s-40s rather than 1870s. This is a pulp adventure in the spirit of the films it draws on, which are full of the same anachronism. Do NOT 'fix' this in future runs.
